subject: health
essentialQuestion: How do respectful words and clear boundaries keep me and my friendships safe?

prompts.prompt: Explain listening and taking turns in your own words and give or identify a valid example.

Use a diagram of a general figure or character rather than your own body, a picture sequence, a model, a described demonstration, or a checked source, to show what you learned about personal body boundaries and unsafe touch.
Apply what you learned about asking for and giving permission to a new fictional situation. Show the steps or name the source you relied on.
A made-up character makes an unsafe or unreliable choice involving secrets, surprises, and telling. Explain what is wrong, correct it, and say why the correction is safer.
Connect listening and taking turns with teasing, bullying, and reporting. Explain how the two ideas support or depend on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Practice and write short scripts for asking permission, saying no, and getting help, using fictional situations only.
Name one skill you can now use somewhere else, one way to check your own work, and one question you still have. This is about the skill, not about your private life; nothing private has to be shared.
